shot_grammar.rhythm: quiet observation → compressed repetition → sudden lateral improvisation → restrained shared resolution

h3_prompt: Clean readable 2D animated fantasy MV, 15 seconds, using the supplied character reference and the supplied mechanical-airport scene reference. Preserve the quiet-looking young magic apprentice: large round face, small facial features, short black hair with slightly asymmetric bangs, pale-purple cheek marks, and a large asymmetric purple living hat with a light diagonal band and a thin feather-like top. Use only the confirmed head and upper-body design; do not invent the unfinished lower body, robe, weapon, wings or mechanical parts. The scene is a monochrome mechanical airport with a clear repeating access route and strong industrial spacing. 0-3 seconds: medium close-up, the apprentice silently watches a mechanical gate repeat its opening cycle while the living hat brim follows the rhythm. 3-6 seconds: close-up of the eyes, hat brim and a gate seam; a brief side maintenance gap appears during reset and both notice it. 6-10 seconds: side-profile medium shot; the apprentice pretends to reach toward the official route, making the gate begin to close, then withdraws the hand. 10-13 seconds: quick lateral camera follow as he changes direction toward the side gap, while the living hat pulls him slightly back to stop reckless entry. 13-15 seconds: the apprentice and living hat turn together toward a safer side route and hold on their shared direction. Make the change visible through gaze, brim movement, hand feint and lateral body direction. No subtitles, no logo, no random text, no ordinary wizard robe, no combat spectacle, no character redesign.
